title: Profit Leakage Recovery: Stop Profit Leaks and Recover Margin
description: Profit leakage recovery playbook — find profit leaks, estimate monthly impact, and recover margin from conversion, billing, and discount gaps.

faq.a: Profit leakage is money you almost earn or keep but lose through funnel gaps and margin waste — including discounts, refunds, failed conversions, and failed payments.
Profit leakage recovery means measuring each leak in monthly dollars, fixing the highest-impact operational gap first, then cutting structural margin drains like evergreen discounts.

faq.q: How do you recover from profit leakage?
faq.a: Measure each leak in monthly dollars, fix the highest-impact operational gap first (often response, conversion, or dunning), then cut structural margin drains like evergreen discounts.

faq.q: Is profit leakage the same as revenue leakage?
faq.a: Related but broader. Revenue leakage focuses on uncaptured sales. Profit leakage also includes keeping less margin on the sales you do win.

blocks.text: Profit leakage recovery starts with clarity: which gaps cost the most each month, and which can you close this quarter? Profit leaks include classic revenue leakage plus margin drains — discounts that never expire, refunds, and unpaid scope.
Find the leak before you recover it

Use the five-question checklist in [how to identify profit leaks](/blog/identify-profit-leaks) or the full [identify profit leaks guide](/guides/identify-profit-leaks). Rough ranges beat perfect accounting when you need a fix-first priority.

items: Rank leaks by estimated monthly $ impact
Close operational gaps first — response SLAs, cart recovery, [failed payment recovery](/blog/failed-payment-recovery)
Then attack margin waste — promo rates that auto-renew, scope creep, high-refund SKUs
Billing declines that become involuntary churn
Missing expansion offers on healthy accounts
